title: Assessing the environmental impact of electric arc furnace slags: comprehensive characterization and leaching analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18210-18219

Every year, a large amount of electric arc furnace (EAF) slag is produced in the iron and steel industries. This study presents a comprehensive overview of their characterisation, and management methods.
